name: Overhead press
summary: Vertical press standing on a band or with the dumbbell, alternating arms.
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width, on the band (or hold the dumbbell at the shoulder).
Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes.
Press straight up until the arm is fully extended next to the ear.
Lower to shoulder height with control.
breathing: Exhale while pressing, inhale while lowering.
harder: Stronger band, slower lowering or one arm at a time with a pause.
contraindications: Shoulder pain when raising the arm overhead.

start.alt: Standing, dumbbell at shoulder height, elbow under the hand.
